```{r}
get_or_download_import <- function(gbif_key = NULL, dir = "data", overwrite = FALSE) {
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE)

  zip_file <- file.path(dir, paste0(gbif_key, ".zip"))

  if (file.exists(zip_file) && !overwrite) {
    message("Plik ZIP istnieje — importuję: ", zip_file)
    df <- occ_download_import(as.download(zip_file))
  } else {
    message("Zapytanie wysyłane do GBIF: ", gbif_key)
    res <- occ_download_get(gbif_key, path = dir, overwrite = overwrite)
    df <- occ_download_import(res)
  }

  df <- df %>% setNames(tolower(names(.)))
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
  st_bbox(c(xmin = 5, xmax = 17, ymin = 44, ymax = 48.5), crs = 4326)
)
poly<- st_sf(geometry = bbox_alps)

#Download DEM
dem <- elevatr::get_elev_raster(
  locations = shp_alps_simply,
```

```{r}
#CHange col names to easier filter
colnames(gbif_download)[which(names(gbif_download) == "decimallongitude")] <- "decimalLongitude"
colnames(gbif_download)[which(names(gbif_download) == "decimallatitude")] <- "decimalLatitude"

# filter GBif data
gbif_filter1 <- gbif_download %>%
  cc_val() %>%
  cc_zero() %>%
  cc_cap() %>%
  cc_urb() %>%
  cc_aohi() %>% # Remove Artificial Hotspot Occurrence Inventory
  cc_zero %>% #	Identify Zero Coordinates
  cc_cen(buffer=500) %>%
  cc_gbif()



```

## Data for ALPS

```{r}

# Convert df to sf
df_sf <- st_as_sf(gbif_filter2, coords = c("decimallongitude", "decimallatitude"), crs = 4326)

# Make sure CRS matches shapefile
df_sf <- st_transform(df_sf, st_crs(shp_alps))

#Simplify alps shapefile
shp_alps_simply <- ms_simplify(shp_alps, keep = 0.01, keep_shapes = TRUE)

# Check which points are inside shapefile polygons
inside_vector <- st_within(df_sf, shp_alps_simply, sparse = FALSE)

# Add 'inside' column to the **same df**
gbif_alps <- gbif_filter2 %>%
  mutate(inside = apply(inside_vector, 1, any))

# Optional: keep only points inside the shapefile
gbif_alps <- gbif_alps %>%
  filter(inside)
```

```{r}
# Map limits
x <- c(4, 18)
y <- c(43.5, 48.5)

# Load world map
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

#LOad DEm FILe
dem_alps <- rast("dem_alps.tif")

#POziomice
contours <- terra::as.contour(dem_alps, levels = seq(0, 5000, 200))
contours_sf <- st_as_sf(contours)

# gradient kolorów dla poziomic
n_cols <- length(unique(contours_sf$level))
col_fun <- colorRampPalette(c("darkgreen", "yellow", "orange", "red", "brown"))



# Plot
map_alps_all<-ggplot() +
  
  # Poziomice
  geom_sf(data = contours_sf, aes(color = level), size = 0.3) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = col_fun(n_cols)) +
  
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +  
  
  # Country borders
  geom_sf(data = world, alpha=0.2, color = "grey40") +
  
  # Border of Alps
  geom_sf(data = shp_alps_simply, color = "red", alpha=0.1) +
  
  # Species points
  geom_point(
    data = gbif_alps,
    aes(x = decimallongitude, y = decimallatitude, color = species),
    size = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Gatunki") +
  
  # Border of map
  coord_sf(xlim = x, ylim = y, expand = FALSE) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "transparent")
  )+
    labs(
    title = "Alpy – Gatunki",
    color = "Wysokość (m)"
  )

ggsave(file="maps/map_alps_all.svg", plot=map_alps_all, width=10, height=8)
map_alps_all
```

## Modelign microclimate and niche feature

Underlying theory and equations of the NicheMapR microclimate model <https://mrke.github.io/NicheMapR/inst/doc/microclimate-model-theory-equations>

TrenchR: an R package for transparent environmental and ecological biophysics <https://github.com/trenchproject/TrenchR>

### 

### Based on Terrain

```{r}
library("TrenchR")  
```

```{r}
# Read DEM file
dem <- rast("dem_alps.tif")
# Convert points to SpatVector
points <- vect(gbif_alps, geom = c("decimallongitude","decimallatitude"), crs = crs(dem))


# Calculate Elevation
gbif_alps$elevation <- terra::extract(dem, points)[,2]  

# Calculate Slope in  and Aspect
slope  <- terrain(dem, v="slope", unit="degrees")  # degrees
gbif_alps$slope  <- terra::extract(slope, points)[,2]


# Calculate Slope
aspect <- terrain(dem, v="aspect", unit="degrees")
gbif_alps$aspect <- terra::extract(aspect, points)[,2]

# Calculate Slope
TPI <- terrain(dem, v="TPI", unit="degrees")# degrees
gbif_alps$TPI  <- terra::extract(TPI, points)[,2]

# Calculate Slope
TRI <- terrain(dem, v="TRI", unit="degrees")# degrees
gbif_alps$TRI <- terra::extract(TRI, points)[,2]

# Calculate Slope
roughness <- terrain(dem, v="roughness", unit="degrees")# degrees
gbif_alps$roughness <- terra::extract(roughness, points)[,2]

# Calculate Slope
FLD <- terrain(dem, v="flowdir", unit="degrees")# degrees
gbif_alps$FLD <- terra::extract(FLD, points)[,2]


```

```{r}
library(geodata)
library(terra)

# 1. Pobierz BIOCLIM (WorldClim 2.1)
bioclim <- worldclim_global(var = "bio", res = 2.5, path = "wc_bio")

# 2. Wczytaj rastry
bio_files <- list.files("wc_bio", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "tif$")
bioclim_rast <- rast(bio_files)

# 3. Przygotuj punkty
points <- vect(
  gbif_alps,
  geom = c("decimallongitude", "decimallatitude"),
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
)

# 4. Ekstrakcja BIO1–BIO19
bio_vals <- terra::extract(bioclim_rast, points)
bio_vals <- bio_vals[,-1]
colnames(bio_vals) <- paste0("BIO", 1:19)

# 5. Doklej do danych
gbif_alps <- cbind(gbif_alps, bio_vals)



```

### Solar Feture

```{r}
lon <- 11.624178
lat <- 47.07708

write.sgrd(dem, "dem.sgrd")

env <- rsaga.env()

rsaga.pisr2(
    in.dem = "dem.sgrd",
    in.latitude = lat,
    in.longitude = lon,
    out.direct  = "pisr_direct.sgrd",
    out.diffuse = "pisr_diffuse.sgrd",
    env = env
)

direct  <- read.sgrd("pisr_direct.sdat")
diffuse <- read.sgrd("pisr_diffuse.sdat")

pt <- data.frame(x = lon, y = lat)

direct_val  <- terra::extract(direct,  pt)[, 2]
diffuse_val <- terra::extract(diffuse, pt)[, 2]

energy_total <- direct_val + diffuse_val
energy_total

```
